limits: Small synthetic samples cannot establish the proposed production accuracy thresholds or a 1% error bound.
The model alias is not an immutable checkpoint.
baseline.json and fresh-holdout.json contain retained failures; recheck.json is in-sample after the first prompt revision.
final-fresh-holdout.json uses 12 newly written frozen samples after the final prompt revision; it is not the earlier tuned corpus.
Subject-first completed zero sampled classifications without body escalation; no efficiency benefit has been demonstrated.
Verification append without a shared explicit non-secret occurrence identifier becomes pending; this prevents unsafe merges but may reduce automatic coverage.
The report evaluates model decisions and local guards, not native provider collection, historical completeness or end-to-end production behavior.
